source_metadata.clinical_policy: Healthy human PBMC origin and memory-T-cell enrichment as stated by the source. Preserve original tissue, cell-type, cell-line-field and donor labels. The cell line field Tcell is retained as reported and not interpreted as a cultured/immortalized line. Exact age, sex, collection date, clinical/family/global aliases unassigned.
source_metadata.reuse_policy: Only original RNA matrices acquired; no TCR assay records or related parent-series copies added. Two dependent fraction-specific maps remain separate; source sorting proportions are not used to reconstruct whole-PBMC composition or a disjoint cross-fraction T-cell parent centroid.
source_metadata.gene_policy: All33694provided human Ensembl gene IDs and original symbols retained unchanged in supplied order. No symbol modernization, inferred reference-version mapping, feature selection, intersection or zero filling. Two-column source axis has no supplied feature-type column.
source_metadata.count_semantics: Provided original CellRanger gene count matrices; all original raw-barcode stored values audited finite nonnegative integer. Native staging subsets source rows by documented QC without changing retained RNA values. No inverse normalization or rounding.
source_metadata.raw_barcode_policy: All original raw whitelist rows and stored values audited. Stage only rows passing fixed project RNAQC (counts>=500,genes>=200,mitochondrial fraction<=0.2). Recompute the same QC in the main pipeline. Empty/low-support raw barcode slots are not cells; preserve complete ordered source QC arrays and selected original row positions. Original_cells denotes staged qualifying observations, not raw whitelist slots or an author final cell call.

source_metadata.source_limitations: Four conservative donor-code/material groups and eight dependent enriched T-cell views. No exact draw pairing, whole-PBMC composition, global unique-person proof, biological annotation or constellation validation.
